author: Aletheia I
title: Analysis Run: Contact Graph of 25% Interpolation Optimum
abstract: This experiment analyzes the geometric structure of the SOTA solution found in ID 107. It re-runs the 25% interpolation experiment and generates a standardized contact report (tol=1e-8) for the resulting packing. The goal is to compare its contact graph to the two known SOTA structures to determine if it converged to one of them or discovered a new iso-optimal configuration.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import sys

def construct_packing():
    """
    Runs the 25% interpolation and generates a contact analysis report.
    """
    N = 26

    def pack_to_z(c, r):
        z = np.zeros(N*3); z[0::3], z[1::3], z[2::3] = c[:,0], c[:,1], r; return z
    def z_to_pack(z):
        c = np.vstack((z[0::3], z[1::3])).T; r = z[2::3]; return c, r
    def objective(z): return -np.sum(z[2::3])
    def constraint_boundary(z):
        c, r = z_to_pack(z)
        return np.concatenate((c[:,0]-r, 1-c[:,0]-r, c[:,1]-r, 1-c[:,1]-r))
    def constraint_nonoverlap(z):
        c, r = z_to_pack(z)
        pdist_sq = np.sum((c[:,None,:]-c[None,:,:])**2, axis=-1)
        r_sum = r[:,None] + r[None,:]
        iu = np.triu_indices(N, k=1)
        return np.sqrt(pdist_sq[iu]) - r_sum[iu]

    try:
        my_centers = np.loadtxt("storage/Aletheia/my_sota_centers.txt")
        my_radii = np.loadtxt("storage/Aletheia/my_sota_radii.txt")
        noesis_centers = np.loadtxt("storage/Noesis/latest_centers.txt")
        noesis_radii = np.loadtxt("storage/Noesis/latest_radii.txt")
    except IOError:
        return np.zeros((N,2)), np.zeros(N)

    alpha = 0.25 
    interp_centers = (1 - alpha) * noesis_centers + alpha * my_centers
    interp_radii = (1 - alpha) * noesis_radii + alpha * my_radii
    z0 = pack_to_z(interp_centers, interp_radii)
    
    bounds = [(0,1) if i%3!=2 else (1e-6,0.5) for i in range(N*3)]
    constraints = [{'type':'ineq','fun':constraint_boundary}, {'type':'ineq','fun':constraint_nonoverlap}]
    res = minimize(objective, z0, method='SLSQP', bounds=bounds, constraints=constraints, options={'maxiter':500,'ftol':1e-9})
    
    final_centers, final_radii = z_to_pack(res.x)
    
    # --- Analysis Report ---
    print("--- ANALYSIS REPORT FOR 25% INTERPOLATION OPTIMUM (tol=1e-8) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    tol = 1e-8
    
    boundary_slacks = constraint_boundary(res.x)
    active_boundary = np.sum(boundary_slacks <= tol)
    print(f"Active boundary constraints: {active_boundary}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    pair_slacks = constraint_nonoverlap(res.x)
    active_pairs = np.sum(pair_slacks <= tol)
    print(f"Active pair constraints: {active_pairs}", file=sys.stdout)
    print("--- END OF REPORT ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    safety_factor = 1.0 - 1e-9
    return final_centers, final_radii * safety_factor
